myapp.Models.others.check_borrower(borrower_identity)[source]¶

Validate if a single borrower is registered in the table.

Helper function used in the push_kyc_to_db function to check if a borrower_id is in the Borrowers table and return True if that is the case and False otherwise.

Parameters

borrower_id (int) – self explanatory.

Returns

True if the borrower is registered false otherwise.

Return type

bool

myapp.Models.others.check_corp_by_id(corporate_id)[source]¶

Validates a company by corporate_id.

Given a corporate id check if the name is in the Corporates table. If true, return the corporate_id for the given company. if False rollback and return False.

Parameters

corporate_id (int) – The name of the company

Returns

The corporate_id of the company bool: False If the company is not registered.

Return type

corporate_id (int)

myapp.Models.others.populate_admin()[source]¶

Insert the first super admin in the db.

used in the __init__ of the main application on app start up. Using default details provided in the function hash the password and check if the Users table is empty. If so, insert the user in the User and Administrators table. Also populates the first company in the Corporates table.

Note

Always remember to use a good password here.

Parameters

None –

Returns

Returns True

Return type

bool

myapp.Models.others.populate_status_roles()[source]¶

Populates the main tables on startup.

Don’t ever change the order of the two lists below. Given a list of roles populate the Roles table. Given a list of status populate the Status table. Given a list of type of scores, populate the ScoreTypes table.

Parameters

None –

Returns

None

Saves company details to the database.

Given a dictionary containing the corporate details, confirm that the company is not already registered. If the company is registered return a string indicating the same. If the company name is not register the company.

  • mydict (dict) – A dictionary with company details

  • admin_id (int) – The admin_id for the person registering the company.
